results.answer: Here are the steps from the VPN runbook for “authentication failed” issues. Try them in order and let me know what happens: 1. Confirm your internet works without the VPN by opening any public website. 2. Check that the time and date on your laptop are correct—a wrong clock can break the VPN certificate check. 3. Quit the VPN client fully, restart it, and sign in again with your company email. 4. Since you see “authentication failed,” your password may have expired. Use the “Forgot password” self-service page from the login screen (it sends a code to your phone). 5. Try connecting from another network, like your phone hotspot. If it works there, your home router may be blocking the VPN port. If none of these work, tell me and I’ll open a ticket for the network team.
